QuestionStmt.S: In series LCR resonant circuit, $R = 800\Omega$, $C = 2\mu F$ and voltage across resistance is 200 V. The angular frequency is 250 rad/s. At resonance, the voltage across the inductance is

Solution.S:
At resonance, $X_L = X_C = \frac{1}{\omega C}$.

$$I = \frac{V_R}{R} = \frac{200}{800} = 0.25 \text{ A}$$

$$V_L = I X_L = I \cdot \frac{1}{\omega C} = 0.25 \times \frac{1}{250 \times 2 \times 10^{-6}} = 0.25 \times 2000 = 500 \text{ V}$$

Thus the correct option is D: 500 V.
